question: How long does delivery take?
answer: Orders inside Pakistan are delivered in 3 to 5 working days. Karachi, Lahore and Islamabad usually get delivery in 2 to 3 working days.
keywords: delivery days arrive when shipping time deliver

question: How much is delivery?
answer: Delivery is free on orders above Rs 3,000. Orders below Rs 3,000 have a flat delivery charge of Rs 250.
keywords: delivery charges fee shipping cost free

question: How can I track my order?
answer: Once your order is dispatched we send a tracking number by SMS and email. You can also share your order number with us and we will check the status for you.
keywords: track tracking status where order dispatched

question: My order is late, what should I do?
answer: If your order has not arrived within 7 working days, share your order number and we will check with the courier and update you within 24 hours.
keywords: late delayed not arrived not received weeks waiting where order

question: What is your return policy?
answer: You can return unused items with tags within 14 days of delivery. Sale items cannot be returned but can be exchanged for a different size.
keywords: return policy return item send back

question: Can I exchange for a different size?
answer: Yes. Size exchanges are free within 14 days of delivery, subject to stock. Share your order number and the size you need.
keywords: exchange size bigger smaller change size swap

question: I received a damaged or wrong item.
answer: We are sorry about that. Please send photos of the item and your order number within 48 hours of delivery. We will arrange a free replacement or a refund after checking the photos.
keywords: damaged broken defective wrong item torn faulty refund replacement

question: How long does a refund take?
answer: Approved refunds are processed within 5 to 7 working days to the original payment method. Cash on delivery orders are refunded by bank transfer.
keywords: refund money back how long refund processed

question: Which payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept cash on delivery, debit and credit cards, JazzCash and Easypaisa.
keywords: payment methods pay card jazzcash easypaisa

question: Money was deducted but my order is not confirmed.
answer: Sometimes a payment is deducted but the order does not confirm. The amount is usually reversed automatically within 3 to 5 working days. Share your order number or transaction ID and we will check it for you.
keywords: payment deducted cut charged money taken not confirmed failed

question: Is cash on delivery available?
answer: Yes, cash on delivery is available across Pakistan for orders up to Rs 25,000.

question: How do I choose the right size?
answer: Each product page has a size chart in inches. If you are between two sizes, we suggest the larger one.
keywords: size chart fit measurements which size

question: Is this product available in my size?
answer: Available sizes are shown on the product page. If a size is out of stock, tap Notify Me and we will message you when it is back.
keywords: available availability stock in stock size colour color

question: Can I cancel my order?
answer: You can cancel an order before it is dispatched. Share your order number with us as soon as possible.

question: Can I change my delivery address?
answer: You can change the address before the order is dispatched. Share your order number and the new address.

question: Do you ship outside Pakistan?
answer: We currently ship to the UAE and Saudi Arabia. International delivery takes 7 to 10 working days and charges are shown at checkout.
keywords: international uae dubai saudi abroad outside pakistan

question: When is customer support available?
answer: Our support team replies Monday to Saturday, 10 am to 7 pm Pakistan time.

question: Do you offer gift wrapping?
answer: Yes, gift wrapping is available at checkout for Rs 150 per order.
